title: Tool Resolution Receipt (Prompt B-B/E, DL-CLOUD-2026-09-25)
description: GENERATED CONTEXT, not SSOT. One record per tool launch/resolution attempt. status semantics: FOUND (path exists, not yet verified), VERIFIED (FOUND + expected sha256 or version observed-matched), MISSING (no candidate resolved; fix is actionable, no install attempted), AMBIGUOUS (multiple writable candidates; fail closed, caller must pick), BLOCKED (unregistered logical_id, or an install action without a valid install-authorization receipt). locator_method is the single winning strategy; version/sha256 are observed-only and null unless actually observed (never fabricated).

candidate_locations.description: Every location checked, in strategy order, with the strategy name.

version.description: Observed only. Null unless a version probe was actually run.

sha256.description: Observed only. Null unless a hash was actually computed or matched.
